Cookies & storage

Last updated: 17 November 2026

Relay only uses what it needs to work. There are no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, so there's nothing to opt in or out of, and no cookie banner.

Cookies

NamePurposeLifetime
sidKeeps you signed in. HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite.Until you sign out, or the sign-in expires (1 week to 1 year, your choice)
relay_age_blockSet only if someone enters a birth date under 16 at sign-up, so they can't retry straight away. Contains no personal data.24 hours

Storage on your device

Relay saves some things in your browser's local storage and IndexedDB, which never leave your device:

  • your appearance settings, so the app opens with the right theme;
  • drafts, sound and device choices (microphone, camera, speakers), game best scores;
  • a copy of recent chats for offline use, and the app itself (service worker), so Relay opens without a connection;
  • secret-chat keys, which can't be exported, and your passcode lock if you set one.

Signing out clears your offline copy. You can remove everything with your browser's “clear site data”.

Embedded content

Videos in Chill and “Watch together” load from youtube-nocookie.com only when you play them. YouTube's own policy applies to that player.
